# Pendo and the night

Once upon a time, fog filled the valley and a shooting star crossed the mist.

Pendo, a tiny lion cub with no mane, whimpered. Mara, a gentle tigress, walked beside Pendo.

King Kojo, an adult lion with a massive black mane and a scarred nose, roared. Kojo nudged Pendo.

Pendo looked up at Kojo. Mara laughed softly as Pendo fell asleep.
